content.text:
The separate roof first-light arm remains **unproved**. Both disposable runs stopped before ignition, so neither establishes roof fire or a light packet.

- In v1, bare coordinates `3156,3448,1` landed the player in the ocean.
- In v2, `0'131,0'143,1` parsed to the intended OMT, but the preserved local position had no support at z1. The player fell to `[3146,3439,0]`; I stopped there.

Both games were saved and quit through native controls, terminalized, and verified exited with their bridge and child processes. The untouched source save remains intact. Safe mode was OFF in v2. Product source and executable readiness matched; no production C++ changed.

The next attempt needs an offline-confirmed supported roof landing tile under the preserved local position, or a verified stair or ladder route from z0. The current evidence does not establish either route. Run logs and witness files are under `build_logs/first-smoke-001/roof-firstlight-*`.

Read-only map inspection established an ordinary roof access route; no new game was launched.

From `[3158,3451,0]`, walk west to `[3151,3451,0]`, south to `[3151,3454,0]`, then west through `t_door_frame` at `[3150,3454,0]` to `t_ladder_up` at `[3149,3454,0]`. Use `world.level_up`; `t_ladder_down` is directly above at `[3149,3454,1]`. The roof tiles along the route to the safe supply tile `[3156,3448,1]` are `t_shingle_flat_roof`; that tile has a lighter and 2x4 fuel, and the prepared brazier is one tile north at `[3156,3447,1]`.

The full read-only tile audit is [roof-access-map-audit.json](/Volumes/CodexBulk/Schanigarten/workspaces/Cataclysm-AOL/build_logs/first-smoke-001/roof-access-map-audit.json), SHA-256 `f3fdfdba6228d648386b26c8714894f01ca45e0affdfeb5e340971344a515696`. It records the path terrain and nearby saved fields/items. Preserve the separate z0 source at `[3159,3449,0]` when interpreting any later packet.

Both failed teleport attempts remain counterevidence; neither established roof fire or light. Their sessions were gracefully closed and process exits verified. The source save remains untouched.
